description:
Position Summary:

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to work inside the Platform team, to manage a mixture of services both on and off the cloud, primarily running on Kubernetes. You will report into the DevOps Lead and support a mixture of software and services.

This is a fully remote role, and we welcome applications from anywhere in Europe.

More details: crystalintelligence.com

Duties and responsibilities:

  • Manage (and build) projects and hybrid infrastructure

  • Configure and maintain internal services

  • Build and maintain monitoring systems

  • Build and deploy environments

  • Drive bare-metal deployment

  • Drive performance and integration testing

  • Improve the current infrastructure

Required:

  • Continuous experience in DevOps/IT system administration for more than 4 years

  • Knowledge and practical experience with deployment and administration of Unix/Linux servers (Debian/Ubuntu, RHEL/Centos)

  • Good understanding of common IT security practices

  • Experience in building and maintaining hybrid infrastructures

  • Experience implementing CI/CD (Github actions a plus)

  • Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Saltstack, etc.)

  • Experience with virtualisation and containerisation tools

  • Ability to perform root cause analysis for production errors

  • Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC2 requirements and CIS benchmarks

  • Working knowledge of databases and clustering (SQL, NoSQL)

  • Proficiency in cloud-based DevOps practices, specifically in Terraform, IaC, PaC

  • K8s experience, deploying, testing and managing a cluster

  • Proficient understanding of Git

  • Experience with log management tools

  • Good skills in scripting languages (Bash, Python etc.)

  • Experience with application & infrastructure monitoring in production environment

  • Good understanding of a software development process, everyday duties will include cooperation with both SW development and QA teams

  • Knowledge and practical experience in Advanced Networking including building and supporting local and global networks, ACLs, firewalls, VPN tunnels, advanced routing

  • Availability to be on call 24/7 (only in case of a disaster)


Would be a plus:

  • Experience with AWS/GCP stack will be an advantage

  • Experience with Microsoft 365 stack will be an advantage

Tech stack:

  • Languages: Terraform, Python, Kubernetes YAML

  • Database: PostgreSQL

  • Platform: Talos, Proxmox
